```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 2. MODULE-SPECIFIC HELPERS ----------------------------------------------------
sample_age_from_group <- function(age_group) {
  out <- integer(length(age_group))
  closed_bounds <- list( `18-19` = 18:19, `20-24` = 20:24, `25-29` = 25:29,
    `30-39` = 30:39, `40-49` = 40:49, `50-59` = 50:59, `60-69` = 60:69, `70-79` = 70:79 )
  for (g in names(closed_bounds)) {
    idx <- which(age_group == g)
    if (length(idx) > 0L) {
      out[idx] <- sample(closed_bounds[[g]], length(idx), replace = TRUE)
    }
  }
  idx_80_plus <- which(age_group == "80+")
  if (length(idx_80_plus) > 0L) {
    ages <- 80:95
    weights <- exp(-0.18 * (ages - 80))
    out[idx_80_plus] <- sample( ages, length(idx_80_plus), replace = TRUE, prob = weights )
  }
  if (any(out == 0L)) stop("At least one driver age was not generated.")
  out
}
sample_conditional_long <- function(
    group_values, probability_table, group_column, value_column, probability_column
) {
  result <- vector("list", length(group_values))
  for (g in unique(group_values)) {
    idx <- which(group_values == g)
    distribution <- probability_table[ probability_table[[group_column]] == g, , drop = FALSE ]
    if (nrow(distribution) == 0L) {
      stop("No conditional distribution found for group: ", g)
    }
    probs <- distribution[[probability_column]]
    if (anyNA(probs) || any(probs < 0) || sum(probs) <= 0) {
      stop("Invalid probabilities for group: ", g)
    }
    result[idx] <- as.list(sample( distribution[[value_column]], size = length(idx), replace = TRUE, prob = probs
    ))
  }
  unlist(result, use.names = FALSE)
}
consecutive_claim_free_years <- function(history_matrix) {
  if (ncol(history_matrix) != 5L) {
    stop("Claims-history matrix must contain exactly five years.")
  }
  apply(history_matrix, 1, function(x) {
    reversed <- rev(x)
    if (all(reversed == 0)) return(5L)
    which(reversed > 0)[1] - 1L
  })
}
expected_lognormal_payment_above_excess <- function(mean_gross, cv, excess) {
  if (any(mean_gross <= 0) || any(cv <= 0) || any(excess < 0)) {
    stop("Invalid lognormal severity/excess input.")
  }
  sdlog <- sqrt(log1p(cv^2))
  meanlog <- log(mean_gross) - 0.5 * sdlog^2
  d <- pmax(excess, 1e-12)
  z1 <- (meanlog + sdlog^2 - log(d)) / sdlog
  z2 <- (meanlog - log(d)) / sdlog
  payment <- mean_gross * pnorm(z1) - d * pnorm(z2)
  payment[excess == 0] <- mean_gross[excess == 0]
  pmax(payment, 0)
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Helper used only for the residual fleet without a direct make/model/year
# CarExpert specification. The hierarchy preserves year, segment and motive
# power as tightly as possible. Crucially, a combustion target is never allowed
# to inherit an EV-only engine specification simply because the same segment is
# available. This avoids unresolved engine-capacity/cylinder fields downstream.
vehicle_spec_compatible_pool <- function(target_motive) {
  if (identical(target_motive, "Battery/Fuel-cell Electric")) {
    vehicle_spec_donor_pool |> filter(motive_power == "Battery/Fuel-cell Electric")
  } else {
    vehicle_spec_donor_pool |> filter(motive_power != "Battery/Fuel-cell Electric")
  }
}
# Shared donor hierarchy. Refactoring the hierarchy into one helper prevents the
# full-row, numeric-field and transmission fallbacks from drifting apart while
# preserving the original matching order exactly.
vehicle_spec_candidate_pool <- function( target_year, target_segment, target_motive, field_name = NULL,
    require_transmission = FALSE
) {
  compatible_pool <- vehicle_spec_compatible_pool(target_motive)
  if (!is.null(field_name)) {
    compatible_pool <- compatible_pool |> filter(is.finite(.data[[field_name]]))
  }
  if (isTRUE(require_transmission)) {
    compatible_pool <- compatible_pool |> filter(!is.na(transmission_group), trimws(transmission_group) != "")
  }
  filters <- list( function(x) x |> filter( year_of_manufacture == target_year, vehicle_segment == target_segment,
      motive_power == target_motive ), function(x) x |> filter( abs(year_of_manufacture - target_year) <= 2L,
      vehicle_segment == target_segment, motive_power == target_motive ), function(x) x |> filter(
      vehicle_segment == target_segment, motive_power == target_motive ),
    function(x) x |> filter(motive_power == target_motive),
    function(x) x |> filter(vehicle_segment == target_segment), function(x) x )
  for (candidate_filter in filters) {
    candidates <- candidate_filter(compatible_pool)
    if (nrow(candidates) > 0L) return(candidates)
  }
  compatible_pool[0, , drop = FALSE]
}
select_vehicle_spec_donor <- function(target_year, target_segment, target_motive) {
  candidates <- vehicle_spec_candidate_pool( target_year = target_year, target_segment = target_segment,
    target_motive = target_motive )
  if (nrow(candidates) == 0L) {
    stop( "No compatible CarExpert specification donor available for motive power: ", target_motive )
  }
  candidates |> slice_sample(n = 1L, weight_by = donor_weight)
}

    residual_ratio_5yr = as.numeric(residual_ratio_5yr) )
assert_columns( racq_vehicle_values, c( "make", "model", "vehicle_segment", "on_road_price",
    "residual_value_5yr", "residual_ratio_5yr" ), "racq_vehicle_values_clean" )
missing_racq_segments <- setdiff( valid_vehicle_segments, unique(racq_vehicle_values$vehicle_segment) )
if (length(missing_racq_segments) > 0L) {
  stop("RACQ calibration is missing: ", paste(missing_racq_segments, collapse = ", "))
}
if ( any(!is.finite(racq_vehicle_values$on_road_price)) ||
  any(!is.finite(racq_vehicle_values$residual_value_5yr)) ||
  any(!is.finite(racq_vehicle_values$residual_ratio_5yr)) || any(racq_vehicle_values$on_road_price <= 0) ||
  any(racq_vehicle_values$residual_value_5yr <= 0) || any(racq_vehicle_values$residual_ratio_5yr <= 0 |
      racq_vehicle_values$residual_ratio_5yr >= 1)
) {
  stop("Invalid RACQ vehicle-value calibration.")
}
# Additional quote-stage variable calibrations ---------------------------------
additional_quote_calibrations <- readRDS( config$additional_quote_variable_calibration_file )
required_additional_calibrations <- c( "parking_distribution_by_remoteness", "finance_distribution",
  "vehicle_colour_distribution", "modification_type_distribution", "pre_existing_damage_type_distribution",
  "annual_km_band_definition", "scalar_assumptions" )
missing_additional_calibrations <- setdiff( required_additional_calibrations, names(additional_quote_calibrations)
)
if (length(missing_additional_calibrations) > 0L) {
  stop("Additional quote-variable calibration object is missing: ", paste(missing_additional_calibrations, collapse = ", "))
}
parking_distribution_by_remoteness <- additional_quote_calibrations$parking_distribution_by_remoteness
finance_distribution <- additional_quote_calibrations$finance_distribution
vehicle_colour_distribution <- additional_quote_calibrations$vehicle_colour_distribution
modification_type_distribution <- additional_quote_calibrations$modification_type_distribution
pre_existing_damage_type_distribution <- additional_quote_calibrations$pre_existing_damage_type_distribution
annual_km_band_definition <- additional_quote_calibrations$annual_km_band_definition
quote_scalar_assumptions <- additional_quote_calibrations$scalar_assumptions
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 4. CUSTOMER AND GEOGRAPHY ----------------------------------------------------
n <- config$n_policies
if (config$n_policies_per_cohort * length(config$cohort_years) != n) {
  stop("n_policies must equal n_policies_per_cohort x number of cohort years.")
}
# Exactly 50,000 independent new-business quote opportunities are generated for
# each annual cohort. The rows are shuffled after assigning policy year so policy
# IDs do not encode calendar year.
policy_year_vector <- rep(config$cohort_years, each = config$n_policies_per_cohort)
policy_year_vector <- sample(policy_year_vector, length(policy_year_vector), replace = FALSE)
portfolio <- tibble( policy_id = sprintf("POL%07d", seq_len(n)), quote_profile_id = sprintf("QPF%07d", seq_len(n)),
  policy_year = as.integer(policy_year_vector), state = NA_character_, age_group = sample(
    driver_age_distribution$age_group, n, replace = TRUE, prob = driver_age_distribution$probability ) )
# State varies empirically by cohort year.
for (yr in config$cohort_years) {
  idx <- which(portfolio$policy_year == yr)
  d <- state_distribution_by_policy_year |> filter(policy_year == yr)
  portfolio$state[idx] <- sample(d$state, length(idx), replace = TRUE, prob = d$probability)
}
# P(Remoteness | State) is held at the Module 0 empirical geographic crosswalk,
# while State weights vary by cohort year.
portfolio$remoteness_area <- NA_character_
for (yr in config$cohort_years) {
  for (s in unique(portfolio$state[portfolio$policy_year == yr])) {
    idx <- which(portfolio$policy_year == yr & portfolio$state == s)
    d <- state_remoteness_distribution_by_policy_year |> filter(policy_year == yr, state == s)
    if (nrow(d) == 0L) stop("No remoteness calibration for ", yr, " / ", s)
    portfolio$remoteness_area[idx] <- sample(d$remoteness_area, length(idx), replace = TRUE, prob = d$probability)
  }
}
portfolio$driver_age <- sample_age_from_group(portfolio$age_group)
portfolio$driver_sex_audit <- sample(c("Female", "Male"), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.49, 0.51))
portfolio <- portfolio |> mutate(
    licence_start_age = pmin(driver_age, pmax(17L, pmin(25L, as.integer(round(rnorm(n(), mean = 18.3, sd = 1.8)))))),
    licence_years = pmax(driver_age - licence_start_age, 0L), cover_type = "Comprehensive", exposure = 1,
    policy_term_assumption = "Full one-year term; no cancellation, lapse, amendment, endorsement or vehicle substitution"
  ) |> left_join(annual_cost_level_indices, by = "policy_year")
# Synthetic localities and shared geographic risk -----------------------------
# One common locality lattice is used across years. This represents persistent
# geographic heterogeneity, while annual State mix changes empirically.
joint_geography_targets <- state_distribution |> select(state, state_probability = probability) |>
  left_join(state_remoteness_distribution, by = "state") |>
  mutate(joint_probability = state_probability * probability)
locality_structure <- joint_geography_targets |> filter(joint_probability > 0) |>
  mutate(n_localities = pmax(1L, as.integer(round(config$target_localities * joint_probability)))) |>
  tidyr::uncount(n_localities, .id = "locality_within_cell") |>
  mutate(locality_id = sprintf("LOC%04d", row_number())) |>
  mutate(latent_geographic_effect = rlnorm(n(), meanlog = -0.5 * config$local_geographic_sdlog^2, sdlog = config$local_geographic_sdlog))
portfolio$locality_id <- NA_character_
for (s in unique(portfolio$state)) {
  for (r in unique(portfolio$remoteness_area[portfolio$state == s])) {
    idx <- which(portfolio$state == s & portfolio$remoteness_area == r)
    candidates <- locality_structure |> filter(state == s, remoteness_area == r) |> pull(locality_id)
    if (length(candidates) == 0L) stop("No synthetic locality exists for ", s, " / ", r)
    portfolio$locality_id[idx] <- sample(candidates, length(idx), replace = TRUE)
  }
}
portfolio <- portfolio |>
  left_join(locality_structure |> select(locality_id, latent_geographic_effect), by = "locality_id")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Manufacture year is sampled from each cohort-year x State fleet distribution.

if (any(portfolio$vehicle_age > config$max_standard_vehicle_age)) stop("Generated vehicle exceeds max_standard_vehicle_age.")
# Make/model/segment/motive power are sampled jointly from the annual fleet
# conditional on cohort year and manufacture year. Physical specifications are
# then attached from the common CarExpert representative lookup; residual gaps
# use the existing empirical donor hierarchy.
vehicle_fields <- c( "vehicle_make", "vehicle_model", "vehicle_segment", "motive_power",
  "vehicle_spec_match_status", "vehicle_variant", "engine_capacity_l",
  "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "power_rpm", "torque_nm", "torque_rpm",
  "transmission_raw", "transmission_group", "unladen_weight_kg",
  "vehicle_spec_source_url", "vehicle_spec_source_access_date" )
for (nm in vehicle_fields) portfolio[[nm]] <- if (nm %in% c("engine_capacity_l","cylinder_count","power_kw","power_rpm","torque_nm","torque_rpm","unladen_weight_kg")) NA_real_ else NA_character_
portfolio$vehicle_spec_imputed <- FALSE
portfolio$power_kw_imputed <- FALSE
portfolio$torque_nm_imputed <- FALSE
portfolio$segment_distribution_fallback <- FALSE
for (yr in config$cohort_years) {
  for (yom in unique(portfolio$year_of_manufacture[portfolio$policy_year == yr])) {
    idx <- which(portfolio$policy_year == yr & portfolio$year_of_manufacture == yom)
    d <- vehicle_make_model_distribution_by_policy_year |> filter(policy_year == yr, year_of_manufacture == yom)
    if (nrow(d) == 0L) stop("No make/model distribution for policy year ", yr, " and manufacture year ", yom)
    rows <- sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), length(idx), replace = TRUE, prob = d$probability)
    sampled <- d[rows, , drop = FALSE]
    portfolio$vehicle_make[idx] <- sampled$make
    portfolio$vehicle_model[idx] <- sampled$model
    portfolio$vehicle_segment[idx] <- sampled$vehicle_segment
    portfolio$motive_power[idx] <- sampled$motive_power
  }
}
# Attach exact representative CarExpert specifications where available.
spec_lookup <- vehicle_make_model_spec_by_year |> transmute( year_of_manufacture = as.integer(year_of_manufacture),
    vehicle_make = as.character(make), vehicle_model = as.character(model),

portfolio <- portfolio |>

  left_join(spec_lookup, by = c("year_of_manufacture","vehicle_make","vehicle_model","motive_power"))
if (anyNA(portfolio$vehicle_make) || anyNA(portfolio$vehicle_model) || anyNA(portfolio$vehicle_segment) || anyNA(portfolio$motive_power)) {
  stop("Annual make/model/segment/motive-power simulation produced missing values.")
}
# Full-row empirical donor fallback for the residual make/model/year combinations
# without a direct CarExpert specification. The simulated BITRE make/model itself
# is retained; only the missing representative specification fields are borrowed.
fallback_idx <- which(is.na(portfolio$vehicle_spec_source_url))
if (length(fallback_idx) > 0L) {
  for (i in fallback_idx) {
    donor <- select_vehicle_spec_donor( portfolio$year_of_manufacture[i], portfolio$vehicle_segment[i],
      portfolio$motive_power[i] )
    portfolio$vehicle_variant[i] <- paste0( "Empirical donor specification: ", donor$make, " ", donor$model,
      " (", donor$year_of_manufacture, ") - ", donor$variant )
    portfolio$engine_capacity_l[i] <- donor$engine_capacity_l
    portfolio$cylinder_count[i] <- donor$cylinder_count
    portfolio$power_kw[i] <- donor$power_kw
    portfolio$power_rpm[i] <- donor$power_rpm
    portfolio$torque_nm[i] <- donor$torque_nm
    portfolio$torque_rpm[i] <- donor$torque_rpm
    portfolio$transmission_raw[i] <- donor$transmission_raw
    portfolio$transmission_group[i] <- donor$transmission_group
    portfolio$unladen_weight_kg[i] <- donor$unladen_weight_kg
    portfolio$vehicle_spec_source_url[i] <- donor$source_url
    portfolio$vehicle_spec_source_access_date[i] <- donor$source_access_date
    portfolio$vehicle_spec_imputed[i] <- TRUE
    portfolio$vehicle_spec_match_status[i] <- "Empirical donor fallback"
  }
}
# Complete isolated specification gaps using compatible empirical donors.
# Direct CarExpert matches are retained wherever present. A donor is used only
# when the representative row itself lacks the required field. Any such use is
# flagged through vehicle_spec_imputed and, for power/torque, the dedicated flags.
fill_numeric_spec_from_donors <- function( data, field_name, flag_name = NULL, eligible_idx = NULL
) {
  if (is.null(eligible_idx)) {
    eligible_idx <- seq_len(nrow(data))
  }
  missing_idx <- eligible_idx[!is.finite(data[[field_name]][eligible_idx])]
  for (i in missing_idx) {
    candidates <- vehicle_spec_candidate_pool( target_year = data$year_of_manufacture[i],
      target_segment = data$vehicle_segment[i], target_motive = data$motive_power[i], field_name = field_name )
    if (nrow(candidates) == 0L) {
      stop( "No finite compatible donor available for vehicle specification field '", field_name,
        "' and motive power '", data$motive_power[i], "'." )
    }
    donor <- candidates |> slice_sample(n = 1L, weight_by = donor_weight)
    data[[field_name]][i] <- as.numeric(donor[[field_name]][1])
    data$vehicle_spec_imputed[i] <- TRUE
    if (!is.null(flag_name)) {
      data[[flag_name]][i] <- TRUE
    }
  }
  data
}
fill_transmission_from_donors <- function(data) {
  missing_idx <- which( is.na(data$transmission_group) | trimws(data$transmission_group) == "" )
  for (i in missing_idx) {
    candidates <- vehicle_spec_candidate_pool( target_year = data$year_of_manufacture[i],
      target_segment = data$vehicle_segment[i], target_motive = data$motive_power[i], require_transmission = TRUE )
    if (nrow(candidates) == 0L) {
      stop( "No compatible transmission donor available for motive power: ", data$motive_power[i] )
    }
    donor <- candidates |> slice_sample(n = 1L, weight_by = donor_weight)
    data$transmission_raw[i] <- as.character(donor$transmission_raw[1])
    data$transmission_group[i] <- as.character(donor$transmission_group[1])
    data$vehicle_spec_imputed[i] <- TRUE
  }
  data
}
# Battery/fuel-cell electric vehicles do not have ICE displacement or cylinders.
# Use zero to encode 'not applicable' in the rectangular modelling table.
ev_idx_specs <- which(portfolio$motive_power == "Battery/Fuel-cell Electric")
non_ev_idx_specs <- which(portfolio$motive_power != "Battery/Fuel-cell Electric")
portfolio$engine_capacity_l[ ev_idx_specs[!is.finite(portfolio$engine_capacity_l[ev_idx_specs])] ] <- 0
portfolio$cylinder_count[ ev_idx_specs[!is.finite(portfolio$cylinder_count[ev_idx_specs])] ] <- 0
# For non-EVs, missing engine displacement/cylinder counts are genuine gaps and
# are therefore completed only from non-EV compatible empirical donors.
portfolio <- fill_numeric_spec_from_donors( portfolio, "engine_capacity_l", eligible_idx = non_ev_idx_specs )
portfolio <- fill_numeric_spec_from_donors( portfolio, "cylinder_count", eligible_idx = non_ev_idx_specs )
# Power and torque are meaningful for both ICE and electric vehicles.
portfolio <- fill_numeric_spec_from_donors( portfolio, "power_kw", "power_kw_imputed" )
portfolio <- fill_numeric_spec_from_donors( portfolio, "torque_nm", "torque_nm_imputed" )
# Weight and transmission must also be complete for the downstream modelling file.
portfolio <- fill_numeric_spec_from_donors( portfolio, "unladen_weight_kg" )
portfolio <- fill_transmission_from_donors(portfolio)
count_unresolved_vehicle_specs <- function(data) {
  c( engine_capacity_l = sum(!is.finite(data$engine_capacity_l)),
    cylinder_count = sum(!is.finite(data$cylinder_count)), power_kw = sum(!is.finite(data$power_kw)),
    torque_nm = sum(!is.finite(data$torque_nm)), unladen_weight_kg = sum(!is.finite(data$unladen_weight_kg)),
    transmission_group = sum( is.na(data$transmission_group) | trimws(data$transmission_group) == "" ) )
}
vehicle_spec_unresolved_counts <- count_unresolved_vehicle_specs(portfolio)
if (any(vehicle_spec_unresolved_counts > 0L)) {
  stop( "Vehicle specification integration produced unresolved core fields: ", paste(
      names(vehicle_spec_unresolved_counts), vehicle_spec_unresolved_counts, sep = "=", collapse = ", " ) )
}
# RACQ-calibrated vehicle value -------------------------------------------------
# RACQ provides 2025 on-road prices. The ABS Motor vehicles CPI ratio supplied by
portfolio$racq_calibration_row <- NA_integer_
for (segment in valid_vehicle_segments) {
  idx <- which(portfolio$vehicle_segment == segment)
  source_rows <- which(racq_vehicle_values$vehicle_segment == segment)
  portfolio$racq_calibration_row[idx] <- sample(source_rows, length(idx), replace = TRUE)
}
portfolio <- portfolio |> mutate(
    new_vehicle_value_2025_basis = racq_vehicle_values$on_road_price[racq_calibration_row],
    residual_ratio_5yr = racq_vehicle_values$residual_ratio_5yr[racq_calibration_row],
    depreciation_multiplier = residual_ratio_5yr^(vehicle_age / 5),
    vehicle_value_2025_basis = pmax(config$vehicle_value_floor, new_vehicle_value_2025_basis * depreciation_multiplier),
    vehicle_value_2025_basis = pmin(vehicle_value_2025_basis, new_vehicle_value_2025_basis),
    new_vehicle_value_nominal = new_vehicle_value_2025_basis * motor_vehicle_price_level,
    vehicle_value_nominal = vehicle_value_2025_basis * motor_vehicle_price_level,
    # vehicle_value remains the observable cohort-year nominal value. The
    # explicitly on-levelled version is retained for later multi-year modelling.
    new_vehicle_value = round(new_vehicle_value_nominal, -2), vehicle_value = round(vehicle_value_nominal, -2),
    new_vehicle_value_2025_basis = round(new_vehicle_value_2025_basis, -2),
    vehicle_value_2025_basis = round(vehicle_value_2025_basis, -2) )
# Annual kilometres ------------------------------------------------------------
# Age and remoteness factors are literature-informed simulation assumptions.
# Motive-power mileage relativities are imported from Module 0.
age_km_rel <- case_when( portfolio$driver_age <= 24 ~ 1.10, portfolio$driver_age <= 59 ~ 1.00,
  portfolio$driver_age <= 69 ~ 0.87, portfolio$driver_age <= 79 ~ 0.72, TRUE ~ 0.58 )
remoteness_km_rel <- c( `Major Cities` = 0.94, `Inner Regional` = 1.10, `Outer Regional` = 1.18, Remote = 1.24,
  `Very Remote` = 1.27 )
motive_power_km_rel <- setNames( motive_power_km_calibration$km_relativity,
  motive_power_km_calibration$motive_power )
if (any(!portfolio$motive_power %in% names(motive_power_km_rel))) {
  stop("A simulated motive-power category has no annual-kilometre relativity.")
}
annual_km_raw <- rlnorm_mean_cv( n, rep(config$target_mean_annual_km, n), config$annual_km_cv ) * age_km_rel *
  unname(remoteness_km_rel[portfolio$remoteness_area]) * unname(motive_power_km_rel[portfolio$motive_power])
portfolio$annual_km <- NA_real_
for (yr in config$cohort_years) {
  idx <- which(portfolio$policy_year == yr)
  scaled <- annual_km_raw[idx] * config$target_mean_annual_km / mean(annual_km_raw[idx])
  scaled <- pmax(1500, pmin(50000, scaled))
  scaled <- scaled * config$target_mean_annual_km / mean(scaled)
  portfolio$annual_km[idx] <- round(scaled, -2)
}
# Voluntary excess -------------------------------------------------------------
portfolio$voluntary_excess <- sample( c(400, 600, 800, 1000, 1500), n, replace = TRUE,
  prob = c(0.10, 0.25, 0.35, 0.20, 0.10) )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 6. CLAIM FREQUENCY -----------------------------------------------------------
age_frequency_rel <- pmin( 2.20, exp(0.00055 * (portfolio$driver_age - 50)^2) )
experience_frequency_rel <- exp( -0.020 * pmin(portfolio$licence_years, 15) )
km_frequency_rel <- ( portfolio$annual_km / config$target_mean_annual_km )^config$mileage_frequency_exponent
# No direct State, Remoteness, vehicle-age, segment, motive-power, engine-power,
# torque or unladen-weight frequency relativity is imposed in the baseline truth.
# The new CarExpert specification fields are observable covariates, not imposed
# causal claims relativities.
vehicle_segment_frequency_rel <- rep(1, n)
frailty_shape <- 1 / config$frailty_variance
frailty_scale <- config$frailty_variance
unobserved_frailty <- rgamma( n, shape = frailty_shape, scale = frailty_scale )
raw_frequency_risk <- age_frequency_rel * experience_frequency_rel * km_frequency_rel *
  vehicle_segment_frequency_rel * portfolio$latent_geographic_effect * unobserved_frailty
# Calibrate P(N >= 1) to 14%, rather than E[N].
claimant_rate_objective <- function(frequency_scaler) {
  idx_2025 <- portfolio$policy_year == config$cost_basis_year
  mean(1 - exp(-frequency_scaler * raw_frequency_risk[idx_2025])) - config$target_annual_claimant_rate
}
frequency_scaler <- uniroot( claimant_rate_objective, interval = c(1e-6, 5) )$root
true_annual_claim_frequency <- frequency_scaler * raw_frequency_risk
# Five-year claims history ------------------------------------------------------
historical_claims_matrix <- sapply(5:1, function(year_back) {
  rpois(n, lambda = true_annual_claim_frequency)
})
colnames(historical_claims_matrix) <- paste0("claims_t_minus_", 5:1)
portfolio <- bind_cols(portfolio, as_tibble(historical_claims_matrix)) |> mutate(
    prior_claims_5yr = rowSums(historical_claims_matrix),
    claim_free_years = consecutive_claim_free_years(historical_claims_matrix) )
# Current year
portfolio$claim_count <- rpois(n, lambda = true_annual_claim_frequency)
```


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 7. CLAIM SEVERITY ------------------------------------------------------------
# The 2025 cohort is the common actuarial cost basis. Historical claims are
# generated at their cohort-year nominal level and separately on-levelled to
# 2025 dollars. The 2025 mean paid severity is calibrated to $5,202.
idx_2025 <- which(portfolio$policy_year == config$cost_basis_year)
# Total-loss payments: cohort-year nominal and equivalent 2025 basis.
total_loss_paid_amount_nominal <- pmax(portfolio$vehicle_value - portfolio$voluntary_excess, 0)
total_loss_paid_amount_2025 <- total_loss_paid_amount_nominal / portfolio$motor_vehicle_price_level
claim_weighted_mean_total_loss_2025 <- weighted.mean( total_loss_paid_amount_2025[idx_2025],
  w = true_annual_claim_frequency[idx_2025] )
target_total_loss_dollars_per_claim <- config$target_total_loss_cost_share * config$target_mean_paid_claim_severity
total_loss_probability <- target_total_loss_dollars_per_claim / claim_weighted_mean_total_loss_2025
if (!is.finite(total_loss_probability) || total_loss_probability <= 0 || total_loss_probability >= 1) {
  stop("Derived total-loss probability is invalid: ", total_loss_probability)
}
# Non-total-loss 2025-basis severity varies with 2025-basis vehicle value.
vehicle_value_reference_2025 <- weighted.mean( portfolio$vehicle_value_2025_basis[idx_2025],
  w = true_annual_claim_frequency[idx_2025] )
vehicle_value_severity_rel <- (portfolio$vehicle_value_2025_basis / vehicle_value_reference_2025)^config$vehicle_value_severity_exponent
vehicle_value_severity_rel <- vehicle_value_severity_rel /
  weighted.mean(vehicle_value_severity_rel[idx_2025], w = true_annual_claim_frequency[idx_2025])
target_non_total_loss_paid_conditional <- ((1 - config$target_total_loss_cost_share) * config$target_mean_paid_claim_severity) / (1 - total_loss_probability)
non_tl_scale_objective <- function(base_gross_mean) {
  gross_mean_i <- base_gross_mean * vehicle_value_severity_rel[idx_2025]
  expected_paid_i <- expected_lognormal_payment_above_excess(
    gross_mean_i, rep(config$non_total_loss_cv, length(idx_2025)), portfolio$voluntary_excess[idx_2025] )
  weighted.mean(expected_paid_i, w = true_annual_claim_frequency[idx_2025]) - target_non_total_loss_paid_conditional
}
non_total_loss_base_gross_mean_2025 <- uniroot(non_tl_scale_objective, interval = c(1000, 100000))$root
true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_2025 <- non_total_loss_base_gross_mean_2025 * vehicle_value_severity_rel
true_non_total_loss_paid_mean_2025 <- expected_lognormal_payment_above_excess( true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_2025,
  rep(config$non_total_loss_cv, n), portfolio$voluntary_excess / portfolio$claims_cost_level )
# Historical nominal gross losses are backcast using the ABS repair-cost index.
true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_nominal <- true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_2025 * portfolio$claims_cost_level
true_non_total_loss_paid_mean_nominal <- expected_lognormal_payment_above_excess(
  true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_nominal, rep(config$non_total_loss_cv, n), portfolio$voluntary_excess )
true_mean_claim_severity_2025 <- total_loss_probability * total_loss_paid_amount_2025 +
  (1 - total_loss_probability) * true_non_total_loss_paid_mean_2025
true_mean_claim_severity_nominal <- total_loss_probability * total_loss_paid_amount_nominal +
  (1 - total_loss_probability) * true_non_total_loss_paid_mean_nominal
true_annual_loss_cost_2025 <- true_annual_claim_frequency * true_mean_claim_severity_2025
true_annual_loss_cost_nominal <- true_annual_claim_frequency * true_mean_claim_severity_nominal
# Compatibility aliases use the 2025 on-levelled truth, because Module 2 fits a
# common technical model on on-levelled historical claims.
true_non_total_loss_gross_mean <- true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_2025
true_non_total_loss_paid_mean <- true_non_total_loss_paid_mean_2025
true_total_loss_paid_amount <- total_loss_paid_amount_2025
true_mean_claim_severity <- true_mean_claim_severity_2025
true_annual_loss_cost <- true_annual_loss_cost_2025
```


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 8. LATENT TECHNICAL PREMIUM --------------------------------------------------
# Calibrate the latent actuarial price scale to mean $1,052 in the 2025 cohort,
# then apply the same multiplicative loading relationship to every year.
premium_loading_factor <- config$target_mean_technical_premium / mean(true_annual_loss_cost_nominal[idx_2025])
true_technical_premium_nominal <- premium_loading_factor * true_annual_loss_cost_nominal
true_technical_premium_2025 <- premium_loading_factor * true_annual_loss_cost_2025
true_technical_premium <- true_technical_premium_2025
implied_true_claim_ratio <- sum(true_annual_loss_cost_nominal[idx_2025]) / sum(true_technical_premium_nominal[idx_2025])
```


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 9. CLAIM-LEVEL EXPERIENCE ----------------------------------------------------
claim_rows <- portfolio |> select(policy_id, policy_year, vehicle_value, vehicle_value_2025_basis,
         voluntary_excess, claims_cost_level, motor_vehicle_price_level, claim_count) |> mutate(
    true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_nominal = true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_nominal,
    true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_2025 = true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_2025 ) |> filter(claim_count > 0) |>
  tidyr::uncount(claim_count, .id = "claim_number")
if (nrow(claim_rows) > 0L) {
  claims <- claim_rows |> mutate( total_loss = rbinom(n(), size = 1, prob = total_loss_probability) == 1,
      gross_claim_cost_nominal = if_else( total_loss, vehicle_value,
        rlnorm_mean_cv(n(), true_non_total_loss_gross_mean_nominal, config$non_total_loss_cv) ),
      incurred_claim_cost_nominal = pmax(gross_claim_cost_nominal - voluntary_excess, 0),
      onlevel_factor_to_2025 = if_else(total_loss, 1 / motor_vehicle_price_level, 1 / claims_cost_level),
      gross_claim_cost_2025 = gross_claim_cost_nominal * onlevel_factor_to_2025,
      incurred_claim_cost_2025 = incurred_claim_cost_nominal * onlevel_factor_to_2025,
      # Compatibility aliases supplied to Module 2 are on the common 2025 basis.
      gross_claim_cost = gross_claim_cost_2025, incurred_claim_cost = incurred_claim_cost_2025 ) |>
    mutate(across(c(gross_claim_cost_nominal, incurred_claim_cost_nominal,
                    gross_claim_cost_2025, incurred_claim_cost_2025,
                    gross_claim_cost, incurred_claim_cost), ~round(.x, 2))) |>
    select(policy_id, policy_year, claim_number, total_loss, gross_claim_cost_nominal, incurred_claim_cost_nominal,
           gross_claim_cost_2025, incurred_claim_cost_2025,
           gross_claim_cost, voluntary_excess, incurred_claim_cost)
} else {
  claims <- tibble(
    policy_id = character(), policy_year = integer(), claim_number = integer(), total_loss = logical(),
    gross_claim_cost_nominal = numeric(), incurred_claim_cost_nominal = numeric(),
    gross_claim_cost_2025 = numeric(), incurred_claim_cost_2025 = numeric(),
    gross_claim_cost = numeric(), voluntary_excess = numeric(), incurred_claim_cost = numeric() )
}
claim_summary <- claims |> group_by(policy_id) |> summarise( observed_claim_count = n(),
    incurred_claim_cost = sum(incurred_claim_cost), incurred_claim_cost_nominal = sum(incurred_claim_cost_nominal),
    gross_claim_cost = sum(gross_claim_cost), gross_claim_cost_nominal = sum(gross_claim_cost_nominal),
    largest_paid_claim = max(incurred_claim_cost), largest_paid_claim_nominal = max(incurred_claim_cost_nominal),
    total_loss_claim_count = sum(total_loss), any_total_loss = any(total_loss), .groups = "drop" )
portfolio <- portfolio |> left_join(claim_summary, by = "policy_id") |> mutate(
    observed_claim_count = replace_na(observed_claim_count, 0L),
    incurred_claim_cost = replace_na(incurred_claim_cost, 0),
    incurred_claim_cost_nominal = replace_na(incurred_claim_cost_nominal, 0),
    gross_claim_cost = replace_na(gross_claim_cost, 0),
    gross_claim_cost_nominal = replace_na(gross_claim_cost_nominal, 0),
    largest_paid_claim = replace_na(largest_paid_claim, 0),
    largest_paid_claim_nominal = replace_na(largest_paid_claim_nominal, 0),
    total_loss_claim_count = replace_na(total_loss_claim_count, 0L),
    any_total_loss = replace_na(any_total_loss, FALSE),
    average_paid_claim_cost = if_else(observed_claim_count > 0, incurred_claim_cost / observed_claim_count, NA_real_),
    average_paid_claim_cost_nominal = if_else(observed_claim_count > 0, incurred_claim_cost_nominal / observed_claim_count, NA_real_)
  )
if (!all(portfolio$claim_count == portfolio$observed_claim_count)) stop("Policy claim counts do not match the claim-level file.")
```


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 10. DATA SPLIT AND OUTPUT DATASETS -------------------------------------------
# Out-of-time model-development split: 2021-2023 TRAIN, 2024 VALIDATION,
# 2025 TEST. This replaces the previous random 60/20/20 split.
portfolio$data_split <- case_when( portfolio$policy_year <= 2023L ~ "train",
  portfolio$policy_year == 2024L ~ "validation", portfolio$policy_year == 2025L ~ "test", TRUE ~ NA_character_ )
if (anyNA(portfolio$data_split)) stop("Unable to assign temporal data split.")
# 10.1 ADDITIONAL QUOTE-STAGE UNDERWRITING VARIABLES ---------------------------
# Generated after claims and split so the previously validated claims DGP and
# train/validation/test assignment remain unchanged.
annual_km_breaks <- c( -Inf, annual_km_band_definition$upper_km[is.finite(annual_km_band_definition$upper_km)], Inf
)
portfolio$annual_km_band <- cut( portfolio$annual_km, breaks = annual_km_breaks,
  labels = annual_km_band_definition$annual_km_band, right = TRUE, ordered_result = TRUE )
portfolio$overnight_parking <- sample_conditional_long(
  portfolio$remoteness_area, parking_distribution_by_remoteness,
  "remoteness_area", "overnight_parking", "probability" )
portfolio$finance_status <- sample( finance_distribution$finance_status, n, replace = TRUE,
  prob = finance_distribution$probability )
portfolio$vehicle_colour <- sample( vehicle_colour_distribution$vehicle_colour, n, replace = TRUE,
  prob = vehicle_colour_distribution$probability )
portfolio$vehicle_modified <- rbinom( n, 1, quote_scalar_assumptions$vehicle_modified_probability ) == 1
portfolio$modification_type <- "None"
modified_idx <- which(portfolio$vehicle_modified)
if (length(modified_idx) > 0L) {
  portfolio$modification_type[modified_idx] <- sample(
    modification_type_distribution$modification_type, length(modified_idx),
    replace = TRUE, prob = modification_type_distribution$probability )
}
portfolio$pre_existing_damage <- rbinom( n, 1, quote_scalar_assumptions$pre_existing_damage_probability ) == 1
portfolio$pre_existing_damage_type <- "None"
damage_idx <- which(portfolio$pre_existing_damage)
if (length(damage_idx) > 0L) {
  portfolio$pre_existing_damage_type[damage_idx] <- sample(
    pre_existing_damage_type_distribution$damage_type, length(damage_idx),
    replace = TRUE, prob = pre_existing_damage_type_distribution$probability )
}
portfolio$policyholder_is_regular_driver <- rbinom(
  n, 1, quote_scalar_assumptions$policyholder_is_regular_driver_probability ) == 1
# Transmission is sourced exclusively from the CarExpert representative
# specification layer (direct match or documented empirical donor fallback).
# No parallel synthetic transmission-by-year assumption is retained.
portfolio$transmission <- as.character(portfolio$transmission_group)
if ( anyNA(portfolio$transmission) || any(trimws(portfolio$transmission) == "")
) {
  stop("Vehicle-specification integration left at least one transmission unresolved.")
}
portfolio$policy_inception_date <- as.Date(NA_character_)
for (yr in config$cohort_years) {
  idx <- which(portfolio$policy_year == yr)
  start <- as.Date(paste0(yr, "-01-01"))
  end <- as.Date(paste0(yr, "-12-31"))
  portfolio$policy_inception_date[idx] <- start + sample(0:as.integer(end - start), length(idx), replace = TRUE)
}
portfolio$quote_lead_days <- sample(0:as.integer(quote_scalar_assumptions$maximum_quote_lead_days), n, replace = TRUE)
portfolio$quote_date <- portfolio$policy_inception_date - portfolio$quote_lead_days
portfolio$policy_expiry_date <- portfolio$policy_inception_date + 365
portfolio <- portfolio |> mutate(
    inception_month = factor(format(policy_inception_date, "%b"), levels = month.abb, ordered = TRUE),
    inception_quarter = paste0("Q", ceiling(as.integer(format(policy_inception_date, "%m")) / 3)) )
if (anyNA(portfolio$annual_km_band) || anyNA(portfolio$overnight_parking) ||
    anyNA(portfolio$finance_status) || anyNA(portfolio$vehicle_colour) ||
    anyNA(portfolio$transmission) || anyNA(portfolio$policy_inception_date)) {
  stop("At least one additional quote-stage variable contains missing values.")
}
portfolio_full <- portfolio |> mutate(
    # Compatibility truth fields used by downstream modules. These are explicitly
    # bound here rather than relying on external vectors during tidyselect.
    true_annual_claim_frequency = true_annual_claim_frequency, true_mean_claim_severity = true_mean_claim_severity,
    true_non_total_loss_gross_mean = true_non_total_loss_gross_mean,
    true_non_total_loss_paid_mean = true_non_total_loss_paid_mean,
    true_total_loss_probability = total_loss_probability,
    true_total_loss_paid_amount = total_loss_paid_amount_2025, true_annual_loss_cost = true_annual_loss_cost,
    true_technical_premium = true_technical_premium,
    # Multi-year nominal and 2025 on-levelled truth fields.
    true_mean_claim_severity_nominal = true_mean_claim_severity_nominal,
    true_mean_claim_severity_2025 = true_mean_claim_severity_2025,
    true_annual_loss_cost_nominal = true_annual_loss_cost_nominal,
    true_annual_loss_cost_2025 = true_annual_loss_cost_2025,
    true_technical_premium_nominal = true_technical_premium_nominal,
    true_technical_premium_2025 = true_technical_premium_2025, unobserved_frailty = unobserved_frailty,
    premium_loading_factor = premium_loading_factor ) |> select(
    policy_id, quote_profile_id, policy_year, data_split, state, remoteness_area, locality_id,
    driver_age, age_group, driver_sex_audit, licence_start_age, licence_years,
    year_of_manufacture, vehicle_age, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, vehicle_segment, motive_power, vehicle_variant,
    engine_capacity_l, cylinder_count, power_kw, torque_nm,
    unladen_weight_kg, transmission_raw, transmission_group, vehicle_spec_match_status, vehicle_spec_imputed,
    power_kw_imputed, torque_nm_imputed, vehicle_spec_source_url, vehicle_spec_source_access_date,
    segment_distribution_fallback, new_vehicle_value, new_vehicle_value_2025_basis, residual_ratio_5yr,
    vehicle_value, vehicle_value_2025_basis, claims_cost_level, motor_vehicle_price_level,
    annual_km, annual_km_band, overnight_parking, finance_status, vehicle_colour,
    vehicle_modified, modification_type, pre_existing_damage, pre_existing_damage_type,
    policyholder_is_regular_driver, transmission, quote_date, policy_inception_date, policy_expiry_date,
    quote_lead_days, inception_month, inception_quarter,
    cover_type, voluntary_excess, exposure, policy_term_assumption,
    claims_t_minus_5, claims_t_minus_4, claims_t_minus_3,
    claims_t_minus_2, claims_t_minus_1, prior_claims_5yr, claim_free_years,
    claim_count, incurred_claim_cost, incurred_claim_cost_nominal, gross_claim_cost, gross_claim_cost_nominal,
    average_paid_claim_cost, average_paid_claim_cost_nominal, largest_paid_claim, largest_paid_claim_nominal,
    total_loss_claim_count, any_total_loss, true_annual_claim_frequency, true_mean_claim_severity,
    true_non_total_loss_gross_mean, true_non_total_loss_paid_mean,
    true_total_loss_probability, true_total_loss_paid_amount,
    true_mean_claim_severity_nominal, true_mean_claim_severity_2025, true_annual_loss_cost_nominal, true_annual_loss_cost_2025, true_technical_premium_nominal, true_technical_premium_2025,
    true_annual_loss_cost, true_technical_premium,

# Latent truth is excluded from the Module 2 modelling file.
latent_columns_to_remove <- c( "true_annual_claim_frequency", "true_mean_claim_severity",

portfolio_modelling <- portfolio_full |> select( -any_of(latent_columns_to_remove), -driver_sex_audit,

# 10A. MULTI-YEAR COHORT AUDITS -------------------------------------------------
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 11. VALIDATION ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Motive-power validation must use the same hierarchy as the simulation:
#   policy year -> State -> manufacture year -> make/model/motive power.
# A raw annual make/model registration marginal is not the correct target here,
# because manufacture year is first sampled conditional on State. We therefore
# reconstruct the exact policy-year marginal implied by the frozen Module 0
# probabilities and compare the simulated portfolio against that target.
# Marginal State x manufacture-year probability for each policy year.
target_yom_by_year <- state_distribution_by_policy_year |> transmute( policy_year = as.integer(policy_year),
    state = as.character(state), state_probability = as.numeric(probability) ) |> inner_join(
    vehicle_year_distribution_by_policy_year_state |> transmute( policy_year = as.integer(policy_year),
        state = as.character(state), year_of_manufacture = as.integer(year_of_manufacture),
        yom_given_state_probability = as.numeric(probability) ), by = c("policy_year", "state") ) |> mutate(
    joint_state_yom_probability = state_probability * yom_given_state_probability ) |> summarise(
    target_yom_probability = sum(joint_state_yom_probability), .by = c(policy_year, year_of_manufacture) )
# Conditional motive-power probability given policy year and manufacture year.
target_motive_given_yom <- vehicle_make_model_distribution_by_policy_year |> summarise(
    motive_given_yom_probability = sum(probability), .by = c(policy_year, year_of_manufacture, motive_power) )
# Exact policy-year marginal motive-power target implied by the generator.
target_motive_power_by_year <- target_yom_by_year |> inner_join( target_motive_given_yom,
    by = c("policy_year", "year_of_manufacture") ) |> mutate( joint_probability =
      target_yom_probability * motive_given_yom_probability ) |> summarise(
    target_probability = sum(joint_probability), .by = c(policy_year, motive_power) ) |> group_by(policy_year) |>
  mutate( target_probability = target_probability / sum(target_probability) ) |> ungroup()
# Include every target category even if a finite simulation happens to draw zero
# observations in a very small motive-power cell.
simulated_motive_power <- portfolio_full |> count(policy_year, motive_power, name = "n") |> complete(
    policy_year = config$cohort_years, motive_power = unique(target_motive_power_by_year$motive_power),
    fill = list(n = 0L) ) |> group_by(policy_year) |> mutate(probability = n / sum(n)) |> ungroup() |> left_join(
    target_motive_power_by_year, by = c("policy_year", "motive_power") ) |> mutate(
    target_probability = replace_na(target_probability, 0) )
motive_power_validation_audit <- simulated_motive_power |> mutate(
    absolute_probability_deviation = abs(probability - target_probability) ) |>
  arrange(policy_year, desc(absolute_probability_deviation))
readr::write_csv( motive_power_validation_audit, file.path(config$output_dir, "motive_power_validation_audit.csv")
)
motive_power_target_probability_check <- target_motive_power_by_year |> summarise(
    probability_sum = sum(target_probability), .by = policy_year )
if (any(abs(motive_power_target_probability_check$probability_sum - 1) > 1e-8)) {
  stop("Internal error: reconstructed motive-power validation probabilities do not sum to one.")
}
readr::write_csv( motive_power_target_probability_check,
  file.path(config$output_dir, "motive_power_target_probability_check.csv") )
observed_claimant_rate <- mean(portfolio_full$claim_count[portfolio_full$policy_year == config$cost_basis_year] > 0)
observed_mean_claim_count <- mean(portfolio_full$claim_count)
observed_zero_claim_rate <- mean(portfolio_full$claim_count == 0)
claims_2025 <- claims |> filter(policy_year == config$cost_basis_year)
observed_mean_paid_severity <- safe_divide( sum(claims_2025$incurred_claim_cost), nrow(claims_2025) )
observed_total_loss_cost_share <- safe_divide( sum(claims_2025$incurred_claim_cost[claims_2025$total_loss]),
  sum(claims_2025$incurred_claim_cost) )
observed_total_loss_incidence <- if (nrow(claims) > 0L) {
  mean(claims$total_loss)
} else {
  NA_real_
}
# The non-total-loss CV assumption is conditional on each policy's expected
# gross severity. Validate it after standardising by that policy-specific mean.
non_total_loss_claims <- claims |> filter(!total_loss) |> left_join( portfolio_full |>
      select(policy_id, true_non_total_loss_gross_mean), by = "policy_id" ) |> mutate(
    standardised_gross_severity = gross_claim_cost / true_non_total_loss_gross_mean )
if (any(!is.finite(non_total_loss_claims$standardised_gross_severity))) {
  stop("Non-finite standardised non-total-loss severities detected.")
}
observed_non_tl_gross_cv <- safe_divide( sd(non_total_loss_claims$standardised_gross_severity),
  mean(non_total_loss_claims$standardised_gross_severity) )
observed_non_tl_standardised_mean <- mean(non_total_loss_claims$standardised_gross_severity)
observed_implied_claim_ratio <- safe_divide( sum(portfolio_full$true_annual_loss_cost),
  sum(portfolio_full$true_technical_premium) )
simulated_finance <- portfolio_full |> count(finance_status) |> mutate(probability = n / sum(n)) |>

simulated_colour <- portfolio_full |> count(vehicle_colour) |> mutate(probability = n / sum(n)) |>

observed_modified_share <- mean(portfolio_full$vehicle_modified)
observed_damage_share <- mean(portfolio_full$pre_existing_damage)
observed_regular_driver_share <- mean(portfolio_full$policyholder_is_regular_driver)
observed_vehicle_spec_fallback_share <- mean(portfolio_full$vehicle_spec_imputed)
observed_power_imputation_share <- mean(portfolio_full$power_kw_imputed)
observed_torque_imputation_share <- mean(portfolio_full$torque_nm_imputed)
validation_checks <- tribble( ~check_name, ~observed_value, ~lower_bound, ~upper_bound, ~unit, "Policy rows",
  nrow(portfolio_full), config$n_policies, config$n_policies, "rows", "Unique policy IDs",
  n_distinct(portfolio_full$policy_id), config$n_policies, config$n_policies, "IDs", "Mean annual kilometres",

  "Vehicle-value floor share", mean(portfolio_full$vehicle_value_2025_basis <= config$vehicle_value_floor), 0,
  config$max_vehicle_value_floor_share, "share", "Annual claimant rate", observed_claimant_rate,

  "Mean paid claim severity", observed_mean_paid_severity, config$target_mean_paid_claim_severity - 200,
  config$target_mean_paid_claim_severity + 200, "AUD", "Total-loss cost share", observed_total_loss_cost_share,
  config$target_total_loss_cost_share - 0.03, config$target_total_loss_cost_share + 0.03, "share",
  "Standardised non-total-loss severity mean", observed_non_tl_standardised_mean, 0.95, 1.05, "ratio",

  config$target_mean_technical_premium - 1, config$target_mean_technical_premium + 1, "AUD",
  "Mean latent geographic effect", mean(portfolio_full$latent_geographic_effect), 0.95, 1.05, "relativity",
  "Maximum motive-power probability deviation", max( abs( simulated_motive_power$probability -

  "Maximum finance-status probability deviation",
  max(abs(simulated_finance$probability - simulated_finance$target_probability), na.rm = TRUE),
  0, 0.02, "absolute probability", "Maximum vehicle-colour probability deviation",
  max(abs(simulated_colour$probability - simulated_colour$target_probability), na.rm = TRUE),
  0, 0.02, "absolute probability", "Vehicle-modification prevalence", observed_modified_share,
  quote_scalar_assumptions$vehicle_modified_probability - 0.01,

  quote_scalar_assumptions$pre_existing_damage_probability + 0.01, "share",
  "Policyholder is regular-driver prevalence", observed_regular_driver_share,
  quote_scalar_assumptions$policyholder_is_regular_driver_probability - 0.02,
  quote_scalar_assumptions$policyholder_is_regular_driver_probability + 0.02, "share",
  "Policy inception date matches assigned policy year",
  as.numeric(all(as.integer(format(portfolio_full$policy_inception_date, "%Y")) == portfolio_full$policy_year)),
  1, 1, "indicator", "Vehicle-segment fallback share", mean(portfolio_full$segment_distribution_fallback), 0, 0.02,
  "share", "Vehicle-specification donor fallback share", observed_vehicle_spec_fallback_share, 0,
  config$max_vehicle_spec_fallback_share, "share", "Finite vehicle power coverage",
  mean(is.finite(portfolio_full$power_kw)), 1, 1, "share", "Finite vehicle torque coverage",
  mean(is.finite(portfolio_full$torque_nm)), 1, 1, "share", "Finite vehicle unladen-weight coverage",
  mean(is.finite(portfolio_full$unladen_weight_kg)), 1, 1, "share" ) |> mutate(
    pass = observed_value >= lower_bound & observed_value <= upper_bound )
cohort_counts <- portfolio_full |> count(policy_year)
cohort_split_ok <- all(cohort_counts$n == config$n_policies_per_cohort) &&
  all(portfolio_full$data_split[portfolio_full$policy_year <= 2023] == "train") &&
  all(portfolio_full$data_split[portfolio_full$policy_year == 2024] == "validation") &&
  all(portfolio_full$data_split[portfolio_full$policy_year == 2025] == "test")
annual_km_by_year <- portfolio_full |> group_by(policy_year) |> summarise(mean_km = mean(annual_km), .groups = "drop")
validation_checks <- bind_rows( validation_checks, tibble(
    check_name = c("Exactly 10,000 policies per cohort year", "Temporal split follows 2021-23 TRAIN / 2024 VALIDATION / 2025 TEST", "Each cohort annual-km mean within 250 km of target"),
    observed_value = c(as.numeric(all(cohort_counts$n == config$n_policies_per_cohort)), as.numeric(cohort_split_ok), max(abs(annual_km_by_year$mean_km - config$target_mean_annual_km))),
    lower_bound = c(1, 1, 0), upper_bound = c(1, 1, 250), unit = c("indicator", "indicator", "km"),
    pass = c(all(cohort_counts$n == config$n_policies_per_cohort), cohort_split_ok, max(abs(annual_km_by_year$mean_km - config$target_mean_annual_km)) <= 250)
  ) )
if (!all(validation_checks$pass)) {
  print(validation_checks |> filter(!pass), n = Inf)
  stop("One or more required Module 1 validation checks are outside their stated bounds.")
}
# Compact portfolio summary ----------------------------------------------------
top_one_percent_claim_cost_share <- if (nrow(claims) > 0L) {
  threshold <- quantile(claims$incurred_claim_cost, 0.99, names = FALSE)
  safe_divide( sum(claims$incurred_claim_cost[claims$incurred_claim_cost >= threshold]),
    sum(claims$incurred_claim_cost) )
} else {
  NA_real_
}
portfolio_summary <- tibble( metric = c( "Policies", "Exposure years", "Mean driver age", "Mean vehicle age",
    "Maximum vehicle age", "Vehicle-value floor share", "Mean annual kilometres", "Mean current vehicle value",
    "Annual claimant rate", "Mean annual claim count", "Zero-claim proportion", "Mean paid claim severity",
    "Derived total-loss probability", "Observed total-loss incidence", "Observed total-loss cost share",
    "Mean true annual loss cost - 2025 basis, all cohorts",
    "Mean true technical premium - 2025 basis, all cohorts",
    "Mean true technical premium - 2025 cohort calibration", "Implied true claims ratio",
    "Number of synthetic localities", "Weighted unclassified BITRE vehicle share",
    "Segment-distribution fallback share", "Vehicle-specification donor fallback share", "Power imputation share",
    "Torque imputation share", "Mean engine power (kW)", "Mean torque (Nm)", "Mean unladen weight (kg)",
    "Vehicle modified share", "Pre-existing damage share", "Policyholder is regular driver share",
    "No-finance share", "Street/open-land overnight parking share", "Automatic transmission share",
    "Top 1% share of paid claim dollars" ), value = c( nrow(portfolio_full), sum(portfolio_full$exposure),
    mean(portfolio_full$driver_age), mean(portfolio_full$vehicle_age), max(portfolio_full$vehicle_age),
    mean(portfolio_full$vehicle_value <= config$vehicle_value_floor), mean(portfolio_full$annual_km),
    mean(portfolio_full$vehicle_value), observed_claimant_rate, observed_mean_claim_count,
    observed_zero_claim_rate, observed_mean_paid_severity, total_loss_probability, observed_total_loss_incidence,
    observed_total_loss_cost_share, mean(portfolio_full$true_annual_loss_cost_2025),
    mean(portfolio_full$true_technical_premium_2025), mean(portfolio_full$true_technical_premium_nominal[
        portfolio_full$policy_year == config$cost_basis_year]), observed_implied_claim_ratio,
    n_distinct(portfolio_full$locality_id), unclassified_vehicle_weight,
    mean(portfolio_full$segment_distribution_fallback), observed_vehicle_spec_fallback_share,
    observed_power_imputation_share, observed_torque_imputation_share, mean(portfolio_full$power_kw),
    mean(portfolio_full$torque_nm), mean(portfolio_full$unladen_weight_kg), observed_modified_share,
    observed_damage_share, observed_regular_driver_share, mean(portfolio_full$finance_status == "No finance"),
    mean(portfolio_full$overnight_parking == "Street / open land"),
    mean(portfolio_full$transmission == "Automatic"), top_one_percent_claim_cost_share ) )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
  target_mean_paid_claim_severity = config$target_mean_paid_claim_severity,
  target_total_loss_cost_share = config$target_total_loss_cost_share,
```
